name: walrus-console-mcp
long_description:
Walrus Console is the developer-first interface for the Walrus network: a hosted place to store, manage and serve data without running your own Walrus client or handling wallets and tokens directly. With this extension Claude can browse your spaces and buckets, create buckets, upload, download, rename and delete files, and issue API keys on your behalf.

Setup takes one Console API key, created at console.walrus.xyz under Integrations.

Docs: https://docs.wal.app/docs/console/overview

console_mcp_allowed_dirs.title: Allowed Directories
console_mcp_allowed_dirs.description: The folder upload_file / download_file may access.

tools.name: ping_console
tools.description: Check whether required Console credentials are present.

tools.name: list_spaces
tools.description: List your Personal and Team spaces.

tools.name: get_storage_usage
tools.description: Get aggregated storage usage for your active Console space.

tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: List buckets in a space, one page at a time. Filter by visibility (public/private) and page by passing the returned next_cursor back as cursor until next_cursor is null.

tools.name: create_bucket
tools.description: Create a new Seal-encrypted bucket. Refuses unless Web Account Address is set in this extension's settings, and, on a space that hands group management to a Key-Admin, Key Admin Address too. Returns identity.owner and identity.members — who the signed transaction makes the owner and which addresses it grants access to — plus disclosure, one sentence on who can read the bucket and on what evidence; show it and confirm the roster before uploading sensitive data. There is no top-level members field.

tools.name: generate_api_key
tools.description: Mint a new Console working API key using the Key-Admin credential. Requires confirm: true and, when supported, an operator-controlled MCP form confirmation.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Read a local file, encrypt it with Seal, and upload it.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a file, decrypt it, and save it locally.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files inside a specific bucket, one page at a time. Page by passing pagination.next_cursor back as cursor while pagination.has_more is true.

tools.name: get_file_status
tools.description: Check the processing state of an in-flight upload. Progress is 1 once completed, and absent when failed. A not-found answer means the job record aged out, not that the file is gone.

tools.name: delete_bucket
tools.description: Permanently delete a bucket. A bucket that still holds files is refused with the file count unless deleteContents is also set.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Permanently delete a single file from a bucket.

tools.name: update_file
tools.description: Rename a file or edit its description and tags.

tools.name: get_bucket_metadata
tools.description: Read a bucket's description and tags.

tools.name: update_bucket_metadata
tools.description: Edit a bucket's description and tags.
